extension.news: [B]5.0.0[/B] - Reworked addon for OpenTV/Nagra backend (Samsung Tizen portal API) - Anonymous auth, new catalog (hierarchy/rails), live TV via btv/services - VOD series/seasons/episodes resolvers with signed playback URLs + Widevine - Reworked search - Modernized stack: tulip 4.x, urldispatcher, netclient, unicache - Removed YouTube bridge and legacy ert.gr scrapers
